name: Germany's Next Topmodel
description: Germany's Next Topmodel is a German reality television show, based on a concept that was introduced by Tyra Banks with America's Next Top Model. The competition is hosted by Heidi Klum. She also serves as the lead judge and executive producer of the show.

videos.title: The jump into cold water
videos.overview: Who will be Germany's next supermodel? 11,637 young women applied! Heidi Klum invites 32 of them to her first show, in which twelve candidates are ultimately selected for the race for “Germany’s Next Top Model”. A hard and merciless battle begins for them, because: They are all attractive, but brilliant looks alone are not enough.

videos.title: New York
videos.overview: Today Heidi Klum is taking her twelve girls to New York. There they watch, among other things, how the crème de la crème of top models - Heidi Klum, Gisele Bündchen, Naomi Campbell and many more - prepare for the Victoria's Secret show and are also allowed to walk down the famous catwalk themselves.

videos.title: Dare
videos.overview: The ten girls from “Germany’s Next Top Model” certainly imagined it differently: At their first meeting with Klum’s husband Seal, the young models wanted to look perfect, but he surprises them in the middle of a visit to the hairdresser… In the next test, the girls have to spontaneously complete a catwalk on the Düsseldorf Rheinbahn. On platform three, the young models present themselves in crop tops, miniskirts and tight dresses - with great success.

videos.title: Between the worlds
videos.overview: The girls spontaneously complete a catwalk on the Düsseldorf Rheinbahn. On platform three, the young models present themselves in crop tops, miniskirts and tight dresses. The passengers applaud enthusiastically. A group of teenagers marvels: “They look really good. Great – they did a great job!” And the male spectators on the platform can only utter one word with their mouths open: “Delicious!”

videos.title: And Action!
videos.overview: New tasks already await the girls: acting training with Erol Sander and another exciting photo shoot with a top photographer. This time it's time to dive on the way to the next round! Shortly afterwards, another challenge awaits Jennifer, Yvonne, Lena M., Janina, Charlotte and Lena G.: the choreographer of the musical “We will rock you” is training with them. Then they have to put what they have learned into practice in front of the camera in extravagant outfits.

videos.title: Sexy moves
videos.overview: Early in the morning, a whole new challenge awaits Jennifer, Yvonne, Lena M., Janina, Charlotte and Lena G. in the race for “Germany’s Next Top Model”: the choreographer of the musical “We will rock you” was flown in from London for rocking dance training. A little later it's time to implement what you've learned! The candidates are supposed to dance on stage in extravagant outfits in front of photographer Norbert Baeres.

videos.title: Bodypainting
videos.overview: Joanne Gair, international body painting artist, transforms the girls into big cats. And they are only dressed in paint. Beforehand, they have to face a special challenge: the girls present themselves at an incognito fashion show in Düsseldorf in front of top model Marcus Schenkenberg. And they can't let the "most beautiful" man in the world make them nervous.

videos.title: Sunny California
videos.overview: Surprise for Janina, Jennifer, Yvonne and Lena G. at Munich Airport. None of them have any idea where they are going. Curious, they open Heidi Klum's letter: “Dear girls, I hope you have recovered a little and are fit for a long journey. I have already prepared a lot for you and I am really looking forward to seeing you. See you in Los Angeles…” It will be interesting to see what the four young models will experience in sunny California.

videos.title: Paris here we come!
videos.overview: Jennifer? Yvonne? Or Lena G.? The winner of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum” will not be announced until March 29, 2006! But all three are already in great demand: While the international agency IMG Models and the German COSMOPOLITAN were already convinced of the winner's extraordinary potential before the broadcast started, the international fashion brand Oui Set (a collection from the Oui Group) is now offering a nine-month exclusive advertising contract as an additional prize.

videos.title: The finale
videos.overview: Showdown in Cologne! On Wednesday evening, the door to an international modeling career opens for Jennifer, Yvonne or Lena: Who will be “Germany’s next top model”? For the broadcaster ProSieben, an innovative project is coming to a successful end after ten weeks: Up to 17.8 percent of the advertising-relevant target group are excited about superstar Heidi Klum and her top model candidates week after week. “Everyone developed really well from day one,” enthuses Heidi Klum. “But only one can become ‘Germany’s next top model’.” Lena, Yvonne and Jennifer have been wallowing in happiness since last week.

videos.title: The first big appearance
videos.overview: Lena Gercke became the first winner of Germany's Next Top Model. It's now into the second round and only a few girls out of hundreds made it to show 1. The first fashion show is coming up in the largest stadium in Germany!

videos.title: Runway training on ice
videos.overview: The girls don't just have to dress warmly in a figurative sense. This week the girls are shooting in the snow and presenting a winter collection. In addition, there are intrigues and lies among the models, which depresses the mood in the model house.

videos.title: Moving into the house
videos.overview: In this episode there is a makeover of a slightly different kind: the girls become mannequins and are given bald heads. The models also receive a visit from a familiar surprise guest who gives them valuable tips!

videos.title: Courage to change
videos.overview: Germany's Next Top Model is not a show for the faint of heart. The girls now have to prove this during the makeover. Long hair becomes short and some even get extensions. But not everyone likes the change...

videos.title: The first fashion show
videos.overview: Eleven candidates are still in the running for the title. This episode is about real jobs and they are tough. Only the best are allowed to walk at a ready-to-wear show in Paris. During the shoot, our models become ice princesses.

videos.title: The first commercial
videos.overview: The Germany's Next Top Model candidates are filming their first commercial with frogs who love to be kissed...

videos.title: The Action Shoot
videos.overview: In this episode, the models are on their own: they have to find three casting locations in four hours. When it comes to action shooting, perseverance is key.

videos.title: Harsh words in Bangkok
videos.overview: Fiona, Hana, Michaela, Anja, Barbara, Anne-Kathrin and Mandy are going on a big trip - they are flying to Bangkok. In Asia, a fashion show for a well-known designer awaits the girls...

videos.title: Stand out on the red carpet
videos.overview: During the shoot, our models become superheroes and on the red carpet they have to compete alongside stars like Robbie Williams or Paris Hilton.

videos.title: Stripping down to paint on Malibu Beach
videos.overview: The top model candidates are once again in great demand: during the body painting shoot on the beach in Malibu, they pose in a swimsuit made of color. On Rodeo Drive, they're supposed to recruit passers-by for an impromptu photo shoot!

videos.title: Revenge on Peyman
videos.overview: It's getting loud at Germany's Next Top Model. Five girls are fighting for the title and this time they can take on Peyman. They let their feelings run wild until suddenly clouds of smoke obscure the sky. Is it getting too dangerous now?

videos.title: Who will advance to the final?
videos.overview: Hana, Barbara and Anni are in the finale of the second season of Germany's Next Top Model. Shortly before the end, our three finalists have to give their all again and demonstrate their own creativity during the shoot. Now it's time to hold on!

videos.title: Final
videos.overview: In the final of Germany's Next Top Model 2007, Hana, Anni and Barbara have to give it their all again. Heidi Klum reviews all of the girls' beautiful moments and finally the jury has to make a decision.

videos.title: What nobody saw
videos.overview: What no one saw: Today there are previously unpublished pictures from the second season.

videos.title: The big casting in Cologne
videos.overview: From over 18,200 applicants, the jury invited 120 girls to the big casting in Cologne. And everyone has one goal: to become Germany's next top model!

videos.title: The Sedcard
videos.overview: Put on your favorite clothes and get in front of the camera! In the second episode, the 30 candidates style themselves for their personal comp card. But not all top model candidates demonstrate a sure hand when it comes to outfits.

videos.title: First trouble in the model house
videos.overview: When 19 girls live together in one house, trouble is inevitable. Gisele, Aisha and Katharina-Yvonne are dissatisfied with the “overall situation” and confront their fellow campaigners. But the conversation turns into a heated discussion.

videos.title: Hair off
videos.overview: In this episode of Germany's Next Top Model, the girls get to work on their hair: the big makeover is coming up. Not every girl likes that - there are a few tears shed at the hairdresser!

videos.title: Welcome to New York
videos.overview: Off to New York! And there are some castings for Fashion Week waiting for our models. But not all girls are allowed to introduce themselves to customers; only the best are chosen.

videos.title: Totally in love on the beach
videos.overview: Now it's getting hot and sandy: During the photo shoot on the beach, the girls have to prove that they have fire in them. True passion should be ignited together with a male co-star. But one candidate takes the motto quite literally.

videos.title: No time for jetlag!
videos.overview: From New York we go straight back to Germany - but there is no respite for the candidates. The first casting is waiting right at the airport! In addition, the girls have to stand their ground during the shoot...

videos.title: Vertical Catwalk
videos.overview: For the candidates, the goal is high: in the vertical catwalk they have to show that they can put on a perfect show despite unusual situations. Our girls also let a lot of their clothes go during the shoot!

videos.title: Off to Down Under
videos.overview: After a long flight, the candidates finally arrived in Sydney - but Vanessa is missing! In addition to cockroaches in the apartment, a new points system is causing problems for the girls. In addition to surfing lessons, the models also have a shoot on the beach!

videos.title: Dance with the Aborigines
videos.overview: For the last week in Sydney, Heidi and Co. have come up with something very special: The girls should put on a fashion show in indigenous costume - including a dance performance!

videos.title: Action training, thieves' tour and dance moves
videos.overview: It was lascivious and sexy last week - now the candidates have to get their act together! One commercial says: extend your claws and act like a tough action girl. Who's running out of breath?

videos.title: Showgirls, kisses and Dita von Teese
videos.overview: Sexy, self-confident and beautiful - this week the candidates are supposed to prove that they too can be lascivious like pin-up girls. And who better to teach them this than world star Dita Von Teese? But not everyone cuts a good figure...

videos.title: Ed Hardy, fitness and a tasty shoot
videos.overview: Ed Hardy's job means action, freaking out and rock'n'roll! And the shoot also demands a lot from the candidates: there is no skimping on chocolate, fish and seaweed. Meanwhile, the finale is getting closer and closer...

videos.title: Cosmopolitan, revenge on Peyman and final decision
videos.overview: The time has finally come: The remaining five candidates from “Germany’s Next Top Model” will be photographed in the legendary Cosmopolitan shoot. But who ultimately makes it onto the cover?

videos.title: Semifinals
videos.overview: It's the question that has been bothering the candidates since the first show: Who will make it to the final? Two places are still open. There is also a large male casting with old acquaintances.

videos.title: Final
videos.overview: Finally the time has come. The candidates fought for their dream for weeks and now the all-important question is being resolved: Who will be Germany's next top model in the third season?

videos.title: Best of
videos.overview: A reunion with all 120 candidates: The first steps before Heidi Klum, Peyman Amin and Rolf Scheider. What happens in front of and behind the scenes? Also: The most beautiful and emotional moments as well as the most exciting photo shoots such as the unforgettable shoot with a baby lion, a chimpanzee, a mastiff and a falcon in the middle of New York. There are also previously unpublished scenes, including a fitness training session with David Kirsch.

videos.title: Casting in Düsseldorf
videos.overview: The first open casting in Düsseldorf: Heidi Klum and her jury colleagues Peyman Amin and Rolf Schneider looked at 1,104 applicants for five hours. Which girls will make it to the first photo shoot and who will have to go home?

videos.title: Casting in Munich
videos.overview: Heidi Klum, Peyman Amin and Rolf Scheider travel to Munich for the second open casting. There are 1,376 applicants in high heels and cool outfits waiting to make their dream come true. Whoever makes it into the model villa is here for you!

videos.title: Ice-cold
videos.overview: The top 30 girls are off on their first trip: their first fashion show and an ice shoot await them in Berlin, where the models have to dress warmly. You can see who it is too cold for and who can melt the ice here.

videos.title: New competition
videos.overview: When they arrive in L.A. there is the first disillusionment: a new competitor joins the group. Larissa, the winner of Austria's Next Top Model. She quickly finds a connection and Tessa as a friend, but unfortunately the harmony quickly evaporates.

videos.title: The Makeover
videos.overview: There is a new styling for the 14 girls. Heidi Klum and hairstylist Helena Faccenda have come up with new looks for the girls. This isn't okay for Larissa, she refuses and freaks out. But Tessa's fuses also blow...

videos.title: Las Vegas Baby
videos.overview: It gets playful for the remaining 13 candidates: Heidi Klum flies to Las Vegas with her models. But the trip is not beneficial for everyone.

videos.title: On the open road
videos.overview: During the photo shoot, the candidates for Germany's Next Top Model could get their feet wet: They pose on the street in the cold rain in front of star photographer Rankin. Who is convincing despite the difficult circumstances?

videos.title: Underwater
videos.overview: The girls get their claws out and Larissa is the total outsider of the group. But the 16-year-old doesn't let the bullying get her down. Especially since there are important castings and a mermaid shoot coming up again!

videos.title: NY Fashion Week
videos.overview: New York shows who has an international chance of becoming a top model. Who gets to go on the catwalk with the professionals at Fashion Week? There is also a hot pole dancing shoot.

videos.title: First commercial
videos.overview: The candidates demonstrate their acting talent and film their first commercial.

videos.title: Style Icons
videos.overview: The girls take on the role of style icons like Marilyn Monroe and have to prove once again whether they have what it takes to become a top model.

videos.title: Really rock out
videos.overview: In this episode the young models are off to Hawaii! The aim is to land an order from an internationally known brand. Then it's back to L.A. to prepare for her rock star shoot. You really have to rock out!

videos.title: Bed of roses
videos.overview: Little movement, lots of expression: A shoot with star photographer Russell James in a bed of red roses awaits the top model candidates. How are the final six doing on the bed of roses?

videos.title: The Cosmopolitan shoot
videos.overview: Only 5 girls are left and only one can become Germany's next top model. This week is the test shoot for the Cosmopolitan cover and the opportunity for the Gillette campaign. The tension is rising and everyone now has to give 110%.

videos.title: Who will make it to the final?
videos.overview: Jessica, Mandy or Marie: Which two girls will make it to the final of Germany's Next Top Model alongside Sarah and for whom will the dream come true? Now only nuances count...

videos.title: The finale
videos.overview: Sara Nuru, Mandy Bork and Marie Nasemann are in the final of the 4th season of Germany's Next Top Model.

videos.title: Best of
videos.overview: Today there is a best of season 4!

videos.title: New season, new jury
videos.overview: Screaming reception for Heidi Klum and her new jury colleagues. In season 5 she is supported by star photographer Kristian Schuller and marketing expert Qualid Ladraa. Well, then the big casting can begin!

videos.title: Fashion Week Berlin
videos.overview: In this episode, Heidi Klum, Kristian Schuller and Q take the 31 girls, who were selected from over 2000 applicants, on their first trip - to Berlin. The first fashion show awaits you as part of “Fashion Week”.

videos.title: Shooting on the suitcase treadmill
videos.overview: This time it's about proving your sense of style: skirt or jeans, blouse or top? At Munich Airport, the girls had to face the jury and spectators. She also expects a strenuous photo shoot on a suitcase treadmill.

videos.title: Oversized dresses
videos.overview: “Germany’s Next Top Model” juror Kristian Schuller is planning the first big photo shoot on Derdesteen Beach in Cape Town. In oversized dresses, the models are supposed to hang on rings or balance on swings and look really elegant.

videos.title: The Makeover
videos.overview: During the shoot in the fashion metropolis of New York, the Germany's Next Top Model candidates have to prove their acting talent. In addition, big tears are rolling down from our models again because it's affecting their hair! It's being restyled!

videos.title: Moving into the model villa
videos.overview:
In this episode, the aspiring models have to prove themselves in New York and show what they have learned so far on Germany's Next Top Model. The girls are also moving: finally off to the new model villa.

After the candidates stayed in a designer hotel on Fifth Avenue in New York, they are now heading to the model villa. Now they have to prove everything they have learned so far in order to survive in New York. After all, only the best girls have a safe place in the new villa.

videos.title: Push-ups, sit-ups etc.
videos.overview:
In this episode of Germany's Next Top Model, things get serious for the girls. You have a literally hot shoot ahead of you with one of the leading photographers in the world. Who can convince the photographer and Heidi and who can't?

Things are getting serious for the girls! Heidi now demands everything from her protégés. A fiery shoot and a tough decision await the models...

videos.title: Shaky party on the beach
videos.overview: It's going to be wet for our models this week! The sexy beach shoot is not hot, but bitterly cold! You can see who can cope with the cold and who fails here.

videos.title: Sexy in lingerie
videos.overview: This week it's going to be exciting for the models: Some of them are allowed to go on the catwalk for Kimora Simmons! There's also a scalding hot lingerie shoot where the girls really have to let their hair down. Who will master this task?

videos.title: Belly dance lessons
videos.overview: In episode 10 it will be exciting and fun at the same time: the girls take on the role of a bird, get some belly dancing lessons together with Heidi and things will be highly emotional with the models this week. You can find out why here.

videos.title: The model circus
videos.overview: The model circus is here! This week the models are shooting with circus attractions, such as elephants! There’s also a huge job to land. However, to do this they have to jump and sing. Who will win the race?

videos.title: Living mannequins
videos.overview: Things are getting tighter for the girls. This week they have to be live mannequins and do real stunts! Plus, some of them get to shoot for Cosmopolitan! You can see which of the girls are particularly under pressure in episode 12.

videos.title: Shopping trip in L.A.
videos.overview: This time the girls are spared nothing from the shopping trip into the mud. However, it's time to close your eyes and keep going, because the season finale is getting closer and even the smallest mistakes can make the difference between a modeling career or a trip home.

videos.title: The pressure is growing
videos.overview: As a model you have to be prepared for anything. You also have to skillfully avoid nasty questions from journalists, and some girls would have made a real embarrassment of themselves. But preparing for the fashion world out there is now more necessary than ever, because now it's all about making it to the final! Of course, every job you get helps you score points with the jury, and the greater the resentment becomes.

videos.title: The Semi-finals
videos.overview: The jury around top model Heidi Klum sends the girls to the track, now the questions are being asked like at school! Commercials, commercial shoots, photo shoots and a running job in Milan: the judges want to see what the girls have achieved so far. Because this is their last week together in the model villa, after that only three of the girls go to the finals and saying goodbye is very difficult!

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: It's time! The grand finale of season 5 of Germany's Next Top Model begins. With a breathtaking stage show and the 3 finalists. There will also be a reunion with the top 18 of this season.

videos.title: Best of
videos.overview: More than 2,000 candidates applied for the big casting in Cologne - one of them prevailed against all her competitors and has been "Germany's next top model - by Heidi Klum" since last Thursday... Today there is a best of the 5th season!

videos.title: World record
videos.overview: Here we go again! Heidi is looking for the most beautiful girls in Germany and is back with a new jury! You can see here why the first decision literally fell through!

videos.title: The Makeover
videos.overview: In the second episode, the aspiring models fly to London and have to face a big change because the makeover is coming up and some are very unhappy about it. Also, the girls definitely need to work on their ego...

videos.title: Royal Challenge
videos.overview: A royal challenge awaits the girls in London: they have to make a member of the Queen's Guard laugh. The candidates will also be photographed by the British star photographer Rankin and this shoot is really something special...

videos.title: Zoff in L.A.
videos.overview: The top model candidates go to L.A. When it comes to allocating rooms, there's a huge clash between Joana and Franzi. Rebecca is slowly becoming a high-flyer and the other models are getting their claws out.

videos.title: Cinematic kissing
videos.overview: A hot lingerie shoot and kiss training with a real Hollywood star awaits the candidates. Joana also threatens to drop out again and sparks fly between Rebecca and Anna-Lena.

videos.title: Overcome fears
videos.overview: The top model candidates are off to the desert. There is camping there and an action shoot awaits the models. Now it's time to grit your teeth and overcome your fear of heights.

videos.title: In a dirndl in Las Vegas
videos.overview: In Las Vegas, a shooting on the trapeze and a casting in a dirndl await the models. They also have to prove their entertainer qualities.

videos.title: Catfight on set
videos.overview: This week our models are burning and floating during the shoot, which unfortunately isn't easy for everyone. In addition, Anna-Lena and Rebecca are, as always, at loggerheads and have their disagreements on set.

videos.title: Model everyday life
videos.overview: This week things continue to be emotional! The girls are really excited because they are allowed to fly to Brazil to live the life of a real model. Nevertheless, the model house blessing is awry and some of our young beauties are upset!

videos.title: Samba
videos.overview: This week it will be colorful & emotional! The girls can try out Brazilian samba and go to carnival! Two of our models are allowed to shoot for Cosmopolitan! But this week is also hard because 3 girls have to leave...

videos.title: Own villa
videos.overview: Unbelievable! In episode 11, the models move into their own villa in the famous Hollywood Hills. Surrounded by stars, they can also introduce themselves for an important customer. But all that isn't enough, she packs her things and moves out!

videos.title: Commercial filming
videos.overview: Our girls let out their crazy side for a shoe commercial in episode 12! They also spend an exclusive evening with Heidi, which becomes very unpleasant for one of them in particular.

videos.title: Underwater
videos.overview: It's Bahamas Time! The girls have a great underwater shoot that looks easier than it is. The jury is also interested in knowing how the girls deal with future hype and follows them with a hidden camera.

videos.title: Shooting on the trapeze
videos.overview: Things get dangerous in episode 14! The girls' task is on the trapeze! There will also be a cute shoot. Sweet as honey because the models shoot with real bees!

videos.title: The Cosmopolitan Shoot
videos.overview: It's getting serious! There are 5 girls left out of thousands, but only three of them can go to the finals. The Cosmopolitan shoot is coming up this week and everyone is nervous. But as a consolation, the models see their friends and family again!

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: An incredible finale! The finalists and the jury delivered an unforgettable evening. Incredible dresses, bright colors and the announcement of a new top model!

videos.title: The 25 most unforgettable candidates!
videos.overview: From the catwalk queen to the gossip sister: In “Germany’s Next Top Model – the 25 most unforgettable candidates”, ProSieben lets the most beautiful, funniest and most unforgettable girls from all six “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum” seasons run across the screen again. Sunshine Sara Nuru, Miss Klartext Anni Wendler or dance miracle Marie Luise Schäfer – who placed themselves best in the minds of the audience?

videos.title: Spectacular start
videos.overview: Lights off, spot on! Germany's Next Top Model is back and with a spectacular start. 51 girls demonstrate their modeling potential in the first episode.

videos.title: Off to Thailand
videos.overview: Our top model candidates are going to Thailand in the second week. What starts out like a fairy tale quickly becomes hard work...

videos.title: Fashion Week Berlin
videos.overview: In the third episode, the top model candidates from Thailand travel halfway around the world to Fashion Week in Berlin! But not everyone gets a job, but one of the girls seems to have a real streak of luck...

videos.title: Hollywood is calling
videos.overview: Our top model candidates are heading to Los Angeles this week. There they move into their brand new villa in the Hollywood Hills. But in addition to all the luxury, difficult tasks also await the girls.

videos.title: The Makeover
videos.overview: Washing, cutting, tears: the models are about to undergo a major makeover. Who gets the brown short haircut? You can see all of this in the entire episode of Germany's Next Top Model.

videos.title: High Up
videos.overview: Things are going high this week for the remaining 15 girls! The top model candidates are transported to lofty heights for a photo shoot in colorful evening dresses. If you're not afraid of heights, you can pack up!

videos.title: Stage Diving
videos.overview: Playing rock star, sports with Heidi, New York Fashion Week with Thomas Hayo and a live walk with mega wigs. A week of extremes.

videos.title: Off to Mexico
videos.overview: White sandy beach, sky-blue sea: In this episode the girls go to the Caribbean in Mexico. For the photo shoot, the candidates have to pose as female fighters!

videos.title: It's getting hot
videos.overview: The hut is on fire! In the new episode of Germany's Next Top Model, this time not only is there a lot of tension among the girls, but the photo shoot is quite heated in the truest sense of the word.

videos.title: The Top 10
videos.overview: This week it's all about making it into the top 10 for our top model girls. Who will make it and who will fail so close to the finish line?

videos.title: Challenges
videos.overview: Heidi Klum always surprises her girls with internationally successful star guests. In the eleventh episode, Naomi Campbell gives the candidates a leg up. During catwalk training on a skyscraper in Los Angeles, the British beauty shows the girls the intricacies of the catwalk. In a challenge on Hollywood Boulevard, the participants get up close and personal with passers-by and try to grab a few items of clothing from them.

videos.title: Close
videos.overview: “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum” up close: At the big photo shoot in this episode, body painting is the order of the day for the girls. Who literally can't get out of their skin? And which girl is doing great in this photo shoot and showing body tension? This episode also contains, among other things: another casting for a major advertising campaign. Who has the best smile and gets the job?

videos.title: Mermaid Shoot
videos.overview: The girls in this episode of Germany's Next Top Model have to go into the net because the candidates have to lounge and pose as sexy mermaids in a fishing net during the shoot!

videos.title: Underwater Love
videos.overview: Germany's Next Top Model is slowly getting into the hot phase: the first finalist will be chosen this week. The candidates also have a hot photo shoot and the Gillette casting is coming up.

videos.title: Cosmopolitan Shoot
videos.overview: The final is in sight and the girls now have to give it their all one last time to secure their places in the final. There's also an exciting shoot for Cosmopolitan coming up!

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: The big finale: Today the decision will be made at the live show in the sold-out Lanxess in Cologne in front of 15.00 spectators in the hall and millions of viewers live on the screens: Who will be “Germany’s next top model” 2012? Which girl will make it onto the cover of German Cosmopolitan? Who gets the contract with the OneEins Management modeling agency including lucrative advertising campaigns?

videos.title: Best Of
videos.overview: Last week the big decision was made – who is “Germany’s Next Top Model” 2012? Today Rebecca Mir presents the 25 most unforgettable moments from “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”

videos.title: Start in Dubai
videos.overview: Germany's next top model is going into the next round. Heidi Klum, together with Thomas Hayo and Enrique Badulescu, is looking for Germany's next top model. Your first stop is Wiesbaden and Dubai.

videos.title: The Shooting Edition
videos.overview: This week on Germany's Next Top Model everything revolves around the topic of shooting. Three major photo shoots are on the program: high up, under water and in the desert.

videos.title: The Makeover
videos.overview: This episode of Germany's Next Top Model is about beauty. The models are given a new look and are restyled. They also have a scary shoot with Zombie Boy coming up.

videos.title: The Runway Edition
videos.overview: They want to be on the catwalks of the world. But the runway is considered the supreme discipline in the modeling business. And every aspiring model must master this perfectly. Our top model candidates have a tough but important week ahead of them.

videos.title: The Film Edition
videos.overview: Curtain up for the film edition. Heidi's girls have the sexy look in photos. But playing with extreme feelings, speaking, paying attention to facial expressions and gestures and then appearing natural: That's what this week's Germany's Next Top Model is all about.

videos.title: The Sports Edition
videos.overview: Ready, set, sport! This week the candidates are made "fit and ready", because endurance and a healthy body are the "A" and "O" for a top model.

videos.title: The New York Edition
videos.overview: Welcome to the Big Apple! In this episode of Germany's Next Top Model we go to Fashion Week in New York. Which models will grab the coveted jobs and who will come away empty-handed this week?

videos.title: The Sexy Edition
videos.overview: Now things are getting hot on Germany's Next Top Model. The models have a sexy shoot on Rodeo Drive, Heidi goes shopping for new outfits with Jacqueline and Alessandra Ambrosio shows the girls how to move sexy.

videos.title: The Transformation Edition
videos.overview: In the Transformation Edition, the girls have to take on a variety of roles and nothing can be embarrassing for them! In addition, the argument with Maike escalates.

videos.title: The Action Edition
videos.overview: Running and a bit of posing? That was yesterday. In the Action Edition the models have to fly, fall and hover. Fear or not, there is one thing you mustn't forget: looking good. Who becomes a real stunt model and who hides away?

videos.title: The Hawaii Edition
videos.overview: When they arrive in Hawaii, each model expects their own editorial shoot. But first the girls have to make their way from the hot jungle to the camp. It's not just the hike that gets people excited.

videos.title: The Music Edition
videos.overview: The top 5 have been determined! Luise, Anna Maria, Sabrina, Maike and Lovelyn will fight for the coveted places in the final. In the Music Edition they extend their claws. The models take on the role of great music icons and no longer allow each other any praise from the jury.

videos.title: The Semi-finals
videos.overview:
The semi-finals are all or nothing. Which of the girls will make it to the big finals and become Germany’s Next Top Model 2013?

There are no more excuses, now it's getting serious! In the semi-finals, the girls have to show what they have learned in the last few months at the Cosmopolitan Shooting and the Gillette Casting.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: The top model finale has been decided: Lovelyn Enebechi has made it, she is Germany’s next top model 2013! In the big live show, the models appear in sexy burlesque dresses, on stilts or as the four elements. In the end, the pretty 16-year-old Lovelyn prevails against her competitors.

videos.title: The 25 Funniest Moments
videos.overview: There's a lot to laugh about in the best of. The top 10 models of 2013 look together at the 25 best moments from all seasons.

videos.title: The Casting
videos.overview: At the big casting in Berlin, the new Germany's Next Top Model jury sees the girls for the first time. Who is convincing and allowed to go to Singapore?

videos.title: Snake Shooting
videos.overview: Shortly before the big fashion show in Singapore, events come to a head. Heidi Klum has to go to the emergency room. But "The Show must go on" - Who will do bravely at the snake shoot and who will be allowed to move into the model villa in L.A.?

videos.title: The Makeover
videos.overview: Snap, snap, the models are getting their hair done - the big makeover is coming up. The shoot also takes place at dizzy heights, which is not good for all girls...

videos.title: The Body Edition
videos.overview: Sport is murder! This week's Germany's Next Top Model is all about fitness. During the casting for their first big job, the girls work up a sweat. The opening shoot with star photographer Rankin is also something special.

videos.title: The Boys Edition
videos.overview: This week on Germany's Next Top Model it's all about boys boys boys. During the men's casting, the models can choose their three favorites with whom they will shoot together. In addition, the first big challenge is coming up.

videos.title: The Transformation Edition
videos.overview: Panic and screaming! This week it's all about "transformation", i.e. the changeability of girls. And they have to prove it in two shoots and with animal partners...

videos.title: The Extreme Edition
videos.overview: This week it's going to be extreme on Germany's Next Top Model. The girls completely freak out during the aggressive photo shoot and the extreme outfits during the live walk become a big challenge for some.

videos.title: The Road Trip Edition
videos.overview: This week the girls are off to the Wild West! There they are shooting their first fashion film with Thomas Hayo and a sexy Indian shoot in the snow is on the agenda.

videos.title: The Expression Edition
videos.overview: This week our models are supposed to show how well they can use different emotions and expressions in a targeted manner. At the farewell shoot, Heidi is completely moved by how well the girls play their roles. However, the decision leads to a scandal.

videos.title: The Fashion Week Edition
videos.overview: This week our girls get to experience the harsh modeling world. In Berlin they run from casting to casting for Fashion Week and in L.A. they have to cut a good figure at the trampoline shoot.

videos.title: The Sexy Edition
videos.overview: This week the models are supposed to show off their sexy side. It gets really cold during the shoot and the top model candidates are allowed to wear the original Victoria's Secret wings during the decision walk.

videos.title: The Girls Edition
videos.overview: This week Heidi is taking a lot of time for her protégés. In personal conversations with the candidates, she comes across some problems that she tries to solve together with them. The girls can also expect a wild shoot with children.

videos.title: The Real World Edition
videos.overview: In this week's Real World Edition, the girls get to experience what it means to be a model. The Cosmo shoot, Go Sees and a real press conference are on the agenda. It's also about getting into the semi-finals.

videos.title: The Semi-finals
videos.overview: Now it's getting serious: which girl will make it to the final of Germany's Next Top Model. A fantastic shoot with Kristian Schuller is on the agenda and one last job is still available.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: In the live final you can expect great music acts, spectacular walks and a fantastic show. Who will be Germany's next top model? Jolina, Ivana or Stefanie?

videos.title: Heidi! Behind the makeup!
videos.overview: On “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum: Heidi! Without makeup!” The life and career of Heidi Klum are examined in more detail.

videos.title: Casting in Cologne
videos.overview: Whether by bus on a tour across Germany or at the first big mass casting in Cologne: you've never experienced the search for Germany's most beautiful girl like this!

videos.title: Casting in Munich
videos.overview: The mass casting in Cologne is over, but the search for Germany's Next Top Model has only just begun. Who impresses at the Bikini Walk and who gets one round further at the mass casting in Munich?

videos.title: The Fashion Show
videos.overview: The top model candidates have completed the bikini walk! Now the fight for the title of “Germany’s next top model” can really begin: Who will master the first fashion show and get to go to Los Angeles?

videos.title: The Makeover
videos.overview: Having just arrived in Los Angeles, things are already getting too colorful for the girls: whether blue, purple or blonde - no matter what happens on the girls' heads, there will be a lot of tears and excitement!

videos.title: The first Shoot
videos.overview: With their new look, the girls now have to stand out in front of the customers: the first big shoot is coming up! Who behaves professionally and doesn't lose sight of the actual goal?

videos.title: At Dizzying Heights
videos.overview: This week the girls are going to dizzying heights: the helicopter shoot requires a lot of courage from the candidates! The models with a fear of heights have to jump over their shadows this week, because in this week's shoot they are posing in a flying helicopter.

videos.title: The Bodypainting Shoot
videos.overview: It's not just colorful at this week's colorful body paint shoot, but also behind the scenes. The sparks are really flying here! ALOHA! This time, “World of Top Model” brings Jüli, Erica and Darya to a casting on the dream island of Hawaii right at the beginning of the show. However, Darya is not very enthusiastic about her rival Erica being allowed to fly too: “I was really happy and then when Erica was announced I thought to myself... does it have to be!?”

videos.title: Underwater Shooting
videos.overview: It's going to be wet this week: During the underwater shoot, the girls have to cut a good figure in a glass water tank! “Benvenuto” is the name for Varisa, Lisa and Darya! “World on Top Model” brings the three of them to the fashion metropolis of Milan.

videos.title: Pure Adrenaline
videos.overview: Germany’s next top model goes wild: The girls have to score points on the field during the football shoot!

videos.title: Bubble Gum
videos.overview: This week a whole new challenge awaits the TOP 10: They have to do their first video shoot!

videos.title: The Bald Shoot
videos.overview: Even though many of Heidi's "girls" are never seen again after the show, some still manage to actually start a modeling career. Ivana Teklic, who came third last season, ran for Dior and Roberto Cavalli, among others, this season.

videos.title: The Dance Shoot
videos.overview: The idea for the “Next Top Model” format came from the American model Tyra Banks, who first went on air with “America’s Next Top Model” in 2003 and still moderates the format today. The show was introduced in Germany in 2006 and has been presented by Heidi Klum ever since. The winner of the first season was Lena Gercke, who in turn hosted “Austria’s Next Top Model” from 2009 to 2012.

videos.title: Ring free
videos.overview: Kristian Schuller, who is known for his large-scale photos, has already put together elaborate shoots for Heidi Klum in previous seasons. For this season, Schuller, who also served as a juror in 2010, has now been hired as a permanent photographer and will be responsible for all shoots.

videos.title: The Semi-finals
videos.overview: Which girls can Heidi Klum and her jury colleagues Thomas Hayo and Wolfgang Joop convince? Who will make it to the grand finale in Mannheim's SAP Arena?

videos.title: Live Show in Mannheim
videos.overview: The grand finale in Mannheim! Today the decision will be made at the live show in the sold-out SAP Arena: Who will Heidi Klum and her jury colleagues Thomas Hayo and Wolfgang Joop choose as “Germany’s Next Top Model” 2015? Which girl will make it onto the cover of German Cosmopolitan?

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: Who will Heidi Klum and her jury colleagues Thomas Hayo and Wolfgang Joop choose as “Germany’s Next Top Model” 2015? Fighting for the title, the cover on the German COSMOPOLITAN, the model contract with the OneEins Management agency and the 100,000 euro prize bonus: Anuthida (17) from Lübeck, Vanessa (19) from Bergisch Gladbach and Ajsa (18) from Tübingen.

videos.title: New Rules, New Jury, New Style!
videos.overview: The 11th season starts with new rules: Team Hayo vs. Team Michalsky.  First, the girls must prove themselves in two rounds, which starts on the catwalk.

videos.title: Two Teams, Two Islands
videos.overview: Off to the Canary Islands!  But not to the life of luxury they had expected, instead finding spartan rooms with bunk beads.  Not every candidate is thrilled about this...

videos.title: It's Syrupy!
videos.overview: Real castings, real jobs, and a syrupy photoshoot: Now the girls have to show what they can do.

videos.title: The Big Makeover
videos.overview: Some must get their hair cut, some get new hair, and some get their hair dyed from one extreme to the other - this means one thing: It is time for the makeovers! And not every girl is excited...

videos.title: Up in the air!
videos.overview: Strong body tension and the perfect expression, and a height of 10 meters!  Not every candidate is happy about this.  After the shoot, the hard model life continues!

videos.title: Let the Puppets Dance
videos.overview: Puppet show on the catwalk! This week, the models must show that they can play other roles.

videos.title: Welcome to Australia
videos.overview: For the models, it's off to Australia! There they find a very special and particularly animal shooting partner...

videos.title: Now it's getting hot and cold
videos.overview: Ice cold elf-like - at the ice shoot in Sydney, the GNTM young models try to cut a beautiful figure for a cool photo as ice elves and lying on ice cubes.

videos.title: The Roaring Twenties
videos.overview: Bye bye hostels with bunk beds, hello villas with queen size beds. Finally, a long-awaited dream comes true for the GNTM young models: a huge luxury villa with an infinity pool.

videos.title: Blind Marriage
videos.overview: “Blind Marrying”: The young models come in white and move under the hood. Instead of a shoot, the top model candidates walk down the church aisle for a one-take fashion film.

videos.title: Sheer Horror
videos.overview: Horror meets high fashion: Heidi Klum sends the candidates to the haunted house. In a scary setting, the young models are supposed to pose in front of the camera in an eerily beautiful ghost look - floating.

videos.title: Tears upon Tears
videos.overview: Back to the 40ies: From Hollywood in 2016 back to the golden age of Hollywood. For the perfect photo, the models pose as 1940s beauties in front of a vintage car in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Advance to the Semi-finals
videos.overview: It's about the semi-finals. Five models from Team Thomas and two models from Team Michael are still dreaming of the title “Germany’s Next Top Model” 2016. Today the girls are walking down an unusual catwalk in floor-length dresses.

videos.title: The Semi-finals
videos.overview: The semi-finals are just around the corner. Who will manage to assert themselves and make it to the final?

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: Heidi Klum was looking for Germany's next top model for 14 weeks. In the grand finale, which for the first time will not take place in a hall but will be broadcast live from Spain, it will be revealed who won the race.

videos.title: An Airport for #GNTM
videos.overview: There has never been anything like this on ProSieben! At the start of the twelfth season of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”, the #GNTM team turns an airport into a fashion hotspot with one of the most unusual catwalks a woman can imagine.

videos.title: The Topmodel Cruise begins!
videos.overview: Pure relaxation on a beautiful Mediterranean cruise? No way: Heidi Klum invites her top 28 to the first #GNTM cruise on the MS Astoria. Right at the first stop before Mallorca, photographer Max Montgomery is waiting in a small bay for a stand-up paddle shoot.

videos.title: A Shoot at extreme Heights!
videos.overview: Today Heidi Klum rappels her young models off Menorca. In elaborate evening gowns, on a large box and in strong gusts of wind, the top model candidates hang in the air from the ship's crane on the MS Astoria a full eight meters above the ground.

videos.title: The big Makeover!
videos.overview: In the City of Angels, Heidi Klum's young models get a new look. Hair off, hair on, hair red, hair blonde – Heidi Klum and her styling team have prepared the perfect look for every girl.

videos.title: Challenges in the Desert!
videos.overview: Photographer Kristian Schuller takes the top model candidates into the Nevada desert and lures them out of their reserve in desert queen outfits. Victoria's Secret model Nadine Leopold gives the young models tips for the perfect photo.

videos.title: As Burlesque Girls in Las Vegas
videos.overview: Star photographer Ellen von Unwerth and Heidi Klum await the top model candidates in one of the largest show locations in Las Vegas - Treasure Island.

videos.title: Graffiti Shoot
videos.overview: In today's episode, Heidi Klum lets star photographer Christian Anwander photograph her models as living graffiti in a halfpipe. Lamps off, black lights on.

videos.title: Animal Photoshoot with the Judges
videos.overview: Who let the dogs out? Today the young models can expect a particularly animal shoot in Los Angeles together with the two jurors Michael Michalsky and Thomas Hayo.

videos.title: Boys! Boys! Boys!
videos.overview: Today's episode has a male star: Wolfgang Joop is a guest and gives the young models a crash course on the subject of androgyny.

videos.title: Getting into the Top 10
videos.overview: This week it's about getting into the top 10.

videos.title: Revelation: The Models in an Interview
videos.overview: Today Bunte editor Patricia Riekel and Bunte.de editor-in-chief Julia Bauer are guests in L.A. and are putting the models through their paces for interview training.

videos.title: Crazy: As Alice in the Doll's House
videos.overview: How does a 1.80 meter tall model fit into a tiny dollhouse? The answer: Only in a fairy tale. “This week my models are transforming into Alice from ‘Alice in Wonderland’,” explains Heidi Klum about the shoot for the twelfth episode.

videos.title: Panic while Shooting Underwater
videos.overview: It's ready! Today the young models go to the diving station in long dresses and pose at a set table with chairs at a depth of around three meters in front of underwater photographer Peter Taras.

videos.title: The Entry into the Semi-finals
videos.overview: This episode is about reaching the semi-finals.

videos.title: The Semi-finals
videos.overview: The #GNTM final will take place in a week and the six semi-finalists Lynn, Leticia, Romina, Serlina, Maja and Céline have to prove themselves in one last, big shoot today: the Cosmopolitan shoot.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: Robin Schulz is currently one of the most successful DJs in the world with around 200 gold and platinum awards, has toured with Justin Bieber and worked with David Guetta (“Shed a light”).

videos.title: Start in the Caribbean
videos.overview: Welcome to Paradise! Heidi Klum invites her girls to the Caribbean for the start of the 13th season of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”. Vacation under palm trees? None. Right from the start, the young models have to prove their talent: During a “Shoot & Walk” they try to win over Heid in a 60-second shoot with expressive poses in their favorite outfit.

videos.title: The Nude Shoot
videos.overview: Rankin is back. In the second episode “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”, head of the jury Heidi Klum invites her top model candidates to a first, big shoot. The first catwalk teaching is also on the program. To make the decision, the young models have to jump from a wooden platform in the water in bikinis designed by Heidi Klum and swim to the beach.

videos.title: Jump into Winter
videos.overview: A particularly sweaty shoot in the Caribbean awaits Heidi Klum's young models. Star photographer Max Montgomery invites the top model candidates to sit on a trampoline in front of his camera. Equipped with thick winter outfits by designer Tim Labenda, they have to jump and find the right pose. In the finale the girls have the chance to get their first job. For a fashion show, designer Christian Cowan is looking for models to present his collection in front of 150 guests.

videos.title: The big Makeover!
videos.overview: Ready for a new look? Today Heidi Klum and her styling team surprise the young models with the #GNTM makeover in Los Angeles. Edgy, cool, elegant or sweet - what do the candidates look like after the makeover? Who gets a short haircut? Who gets a completely new hair color? Who gets bangs?

videos.title: The Unicorn Rodeo
videos.overview: Heidi Klum surprises her young models with a shoot with photographer Shane Russeck. The challenge: To get the perfect photo, the top model candidates have to find the right pose on a rodeo unicorn... In the elevator challenge, one candidate from the white team and one candidate from the black team have to change in a moving elevator within 40 seconds. They present their outfit to special guest and influencer Caro Daur.

videos.title: Hip-Hop Edition
videos.overview: For a music video shoot, US rapper Brooke Candy shows the young models a 30-second hip hop performance with lyrics, which they then have to dance in front of the camera. For the decision, Heidi Klum's top model candidates are asked to dance by rapper Cro. To create a lasting impression, the young models have to come up with their own performance in teams, which they dance next to the singer in colorful hip hop outfits.

videos.title: Boys, Boys, Boys
videos.overview: The 1920s are making a comeback today. Star photographer Yu Tsai captures the top model candidates in glittering 1920s outfits next to a male model. To make the decision, the #GNTM team transformed a real prison into a fashion hotspot. The top model candidates have to walk through a prison corridor in long robes and not be distracted by the loud prison inmates on the other side of the fence.

videos.title: Magic Bride
videos.overview: Paris, je t’aime: Bruna, Christina, Trixi and Sara fly to the city of love for a casting for the fashion magazine Elle. In Paris they have to impress with their modeling qualities for a major fashion series. Who will be “Miss Top Model”? Who gets the crown? In the decision, the young models have to prove themselves for the first time in a “Miss pageant” alongside a competitor from their team. To do this, every model has to make a plea about herself and her competitor.

videos.title: Action Edition
videos.overview: Under the Caribbean sun - the top model candidates get the chance for a big job at the “About You” casting. To do this, the two of them have to recite a commercial on the topic of friendship. Who gets the job and gets to fly to Cuba? To make the decision, the catwalk rotates 90 degrees: the young models have to walk almost 20 meters along a container wall in bodysuits towards the jury during the vertical walk.

videos.title: It gets acrobatic
videos.overview: “Disney glamour” on “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”: For a fashion show, the candidates transform themselves into extravagant versions of the cartoon icons Mickey and Minnie Mouse. With momentum for the perfect fashion shot: A rope, a large ring and two gymnastics rings - the young models have to choose one of the sports equipment and use it for an unusual pose. And who gets a leading role in Wincent Weiss' music video?

videos.title: Shooting on Wheels
videos.overview: Fashion photographer Christian Anwander chauffeurs the #GNTM top ten through L.A. - not in a darkened limousine, but in an open trailer with a shower. True to the motto: watching is welcome! When casting for Venus and Braun's joint summer campaign, the influencer talent of the model candidates is in demand. For the coveted #GNTM job, they present various bathing utensils in the style of a video tutorial.

videos.title: Family & Friends
videos.overview: Voluminous hairstyles and colorful shift dresses - styled like American housewives of the 60s, the #GNTM models film a commercial for household products. Adrien Brody, Sienna Miller, Ashley Graham and Queen Latifah - Heidi Klum shows two of her #GNTM models the world of stars and starlets at the charity gala.

videos.title: Water Edition
videos.overview: Three weeks before the final, Heidi Klum invited a special guest for a special decision: Designer Wolfgang Joop, alongside the head of the jury, Thomas Hayo and Michael Michalsky, judged how the top model candidates walked down a rainy catwalk in elaborate dresses. Strong nerves are required: The models go on a dive in the Aquarium of the Pacific for the underwater shoot. Julianna, Christina and Jennifer fight for one of the biggest jobs in New York.

videos.title: Drag Edition
videos.overview: Heidi Klum surprises her #GNTM candidates with a special star guest two weeks before the final: Alessandra Ambrosio is in front of the camera during the photo shoot. Dazzling outfits, artistic makeup and killer high heels - six drag queens transform the #GNTM models into their twins for the decision walk. And: Selfie star wanted - who will get the last job at #GNTM?

videos.title: The Semi-finals
videos.overview: In the middle of the American desert, the semi-finalists have to pose in designer clothes in front of the lens of fashion photographer Regan Cameron. And the last decision-making walk before the #GNTM final is coming up; Jean Paul Gaultier personally selects haute couture gowns for the #GNTM models, which they have to present with extravagant poses. Which top model candidates can convince jury boss Heidi Klum of their performance and make it to the #GNTM final?

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: Heidi Klum selects “Germany’s Next Top Model” 2018 together with the jurors Thomas Hayo and Michael Michalsky in the Düsseldorf ISS Dome. Heidi Klum: “After four years we are finally back in the Rhineland. This will be a very special final show.” At the #GNTM final 2018, just like in 2017, there will be no cell phones in the arena. Spectators are prohibited from having these with them.

videos.title: Dinner with Heidi
videos.overview: At the start of the new season, Heidi Klum meets her top 50 model candidates for dinner in Berlin and reveals the first surprise: the first fashion show for the German fashion designer and designer Michael Michalsky awaits the excited women.

videos.title: Shooting in the Snowstorm
videos.overview: Heidi Klum is traveling to the Austrian Alps with her model candidates today. The girls are transformed into snow queens for a new photo series.

videos.title: The mountain is calling!
videos.overview: The mountain is calling! Things will be particularly hot for the remaining candidates this week: At the Alm shoot with a male model, the young models have the task of demonstrating their posing in their underwear.

videos.title: Los Angeles
videos.overview: Let's go to Los Angeles in the US state of California! After their arrival, the girls are immediately shown the stressful everyday life of a model in the weekly competition.

videos.title: The Makeover
videos.overview: The makeover is coming up: Heidi Klum takes out the scissors and half the girls will be hysterical! Since Kim Hnizdo (2016) at the latest, the candidates have known that 40 cm can sometimes be cut off.

videos.title: The first Jobs
videos.overview: The competition begins! The remaining model candidates are fighting for the first job of the season and want to convince the customer of themselves.

videos.title: The Models show a lot of Skin
videos.overview: Heidi unexpectedly takes a closer look at the model villa and checks which candidate can impress with cool styling in her private life.

videos.title: Welcome to Miami!
videos.overview: Welcome to Miami! The young models take part in a casting marathon in the dream metropolis of Florida. Back in Los Angeles, the shoot shows which candidate dares to jump into the deep end.

videos.title: Clear the ring!
videos.overview: Clear the ring for Heidi Klum's top model candidates! In the ninth episode of #GNTM, the young models stand in front of the camera as tamers with exotic shooting partners.

videos.title: Turn the music on!
videos.overview: Turn the music on! The #GNTM candidates have to demonstrate their body awareness and impress with their dance performance during the video shoot à la “Saturday Night Fever”.

videos.title: Boys. Boys. Boys.
videos.overview: Boys, Boys, Boys: In the chic villa, Heidi Klum's proven guest juror and designer Michael Michalsky introduces the young models to their next shooting partners: The candidates are supposed to prove themselves in front of the camera with ten well-trained male models.

videos.title: New York, New York!
videos.overview: New York, New York! Heidi Klum surprises her #GNTM models with an invitation to the exclusive amfAR gala. In glamorous designer gowns, two top model candidates walk the red carpet together with the model director and mingle with the prominent guests.

videos.title: It's going high!
videos.overview: It's going high! The shooting in episode 13 of #GNTM not only requires acrobatic talent, but also a head for heights. Because the top model candidates pose on a bicycle floating in the air.

videos.title: Show your personality!
videos.overview: Show your personality! The #GNTM models have to develop a unique running style on the catwalk and present it together with a specially created look.

videos.title: Semifinals
videos.overview: Semifinals at #GNTM! At the cover shoot for the German Harper's Bazaar, the top model candidates have to prove who has what it takes to become a supermodel and fight in the final to appear on the cover of the renowned fashion magazine.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: Finale at #GNTM! Model boss Heidi Klum took her young models on an exciting journey into the world of fashion in the 14th season of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”.

videos.title: Girls, Models, Munich!
videos.overview: Girls, models, Munich! The 15th season starts in the Bavarian metropolis. At an open casting in the Olympic Park, Heidi Klum and the English fashion designer Julien Macdonald select the girls who will be allowed to go on the big #GNTM trip with her.

videos.title: Welcome to the Jungle!
videos.overview: The professionals who will support Heidi Klum this season include actress Milla Jovovic, who also works as a model, American fashion designer “The Blonds”, star photographer Rankin and English fashion designer Julien MacDonald.

videos.title: The Nude Shoot
videos.overview: The candidates for top models go to the beach in Costa Rica for a photo shoot. In an exotic setting, they have a rather unusual partner in front of the camera: a horse.

videos.title: Time for Action!
videos.overview: Who knows how well the candidates will be able to cope with their new tasks? The demands on the models will certainly increase, and the jury will no longer turn a blind eye to the evaluation.

videos.title: Makeover
videos.overview: Modeling doesn't just mean having an attractive appearance. Heidi Klum will once again give her ambitious candidates for the title of top model 2020 tasks that will demand a lot from them.

videos.title: The big Crawl
videos.overview: Scorpions, spiders, cockroaches: Today, the top model candidates are not allowed to show any fear of contact during the insect shoot, because the small insects sit right in the middle of their faces.

videos.title: Everybody comes to Hollywood!
videos.overview: The remaining model candidates have already successfully overcome some important hurdles. Now it depends on how they continue to prove themselves and whether they are actually able to demonstrate professionalism.

videos.title: Catwalk-Time!
videos.overview: Things get serious today because it's catwalk time! The #GNTM models can expect an appearance on a catwalk at Berlin Fashion Week. There they have to go through some castings.

videos.title: Color Splash
videos.overview: A challenging photo shoot with Kristian Schuller is on the agenda today for the remaining models in the competition. Choreographer Micky K. will ensure that the title candidates show their best side in front of the adventurous backdrop of a desert.

videos.title: Wild Wild West
videos.overview: The Wild West has it all, that's what the candidates for the title of next top model find out at the cowgirl shoot. A professional stunt team provides assistance so that they come across as authentic.

videos.title: Boys Boys Boys!
videos.overview: Boys Boys Boys – in episode eleven the #GNTM models shoot together with male models in an underwater ice world. The #GNTM candidates also get another chance to land an exciting job at a casting.

videos.title: Calendar Girls
videos.overview: Today we're going to the "amfAR Gala", the unofficial start of New York Fashion Week. Heidi Klum will take some of her contenders for the title of top model with her to the American metropolis and will certainly present herself there again in an eye-catching outfit.

videos.title: Over The Edge
videos.overview: Today the top model candidates have to prove that they have strong nerves. Because for the photo shoot it really goes very high. Afterwards, Nicole Scherzinger, the front woman of the “Pusscat Dolls”, awaits the aspiring models with the next challenge.

videos.title: Transformation
videos.overview: Today's motto: "Transformation - how changeable are you?" As a coach at Heidi Klum's side: Thomas Hayo, who wants to get as many personalities out of the #GNTM models as possible.

videos.title: The cover is yours!
videos.overview: The cover is yours! Today is the important cover shoot for Harper’s Bazaar. Back in the model villa, the #GNTM models are surprised by their loved ones.

videos.title: Semifinals
videos.overview: Surprise Surprise! At the airport in Los Angeles, the last six #GNTM models find out that their journey continues for another round. Today there is a photo shoot at dizzy heights, which requires physical sensitivity and fearlessness.

videos.title: The grand Finale
videos.overview: After an entertaining journey through the fashion world, the top model candidates face their final challenge of the 15th season of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”.

videos.title: Germany's next top model - The most beautiful moments, the most unforgettable girls
videos.overview: The best of 2020 and the funniest moments.

videos.title: High Fashion in Berlin
videos.overview: High fashion in Berlin! At the start of the 16th season of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”, Heidi Klum surprised her young models in the German fashion metropolis with a glamorous fashion show.

videos.title: Welcome to the Modeloft!
videos.overview: Welcome to the Modeloft! In the second episode, after moving into the loft, the first shoot of the season takes place: in front of star photographer Rankin's camera, the top model candidates have the unique chance to shine alongside Heidi Klum in the campaign shoot for the start of the 16th season.

videos.title: Primaballerina
videos.overview: Primaballerina! During the shoot in the third episode, the top model candidates transform into mystical ballet dancers and demonstrate their body awareness and mobility.

videos.title: Fashion Divas and Roller Girls
videos.overview: Fashion Diva! In the fourth episode of #GNTM, the multitasking talent of the top model candidates is in demand. During the photo shoot, they not only have to pose confidently alongside several dogs and with their hands full of shopping bags, but they also have to keep their balance on roller skates.

videos.title: The big #GNTM Makeover
videos.overview: Snap, snap, hair off! The big #GNTM makeover is coming up and Heidi Klum has come up with an individual look for each top model candidate: bangs or pixie cut? Blonde bob or dark curls and extensions?

videos.title: Sedcard Shooting
videos.overview: Winter Wonderland: Heidi Klum's models transform into ice princesses on the catwalk. In addition, one of the most important photo shoots of the entire season is coming up: the comp card shoot!

videos.title: Back to the 80's!
videos.overview: Neon leggings, colorful cuffs and teased XXL hairstyles. For the video shoot in the seventh episode of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum” (Thursday, March 18th) we go back to the 80s. “I like these bright, colorful outfits.

videos.title: Strike A Pose
videos.overview: Strike A Pose! During the shoot in the eighth #GNTM episode, the top model candidates stand in front of the camera in a huge, rotating cube.

videos.title: And Action!
videos.overview: And action! The ninth episode has a spectacular high-altitude shoot at a height of 125 meters. Heidi Klum demands mobility, elegance and absolute fearlessness from the top model candidates.

videos.title: Berlin is calling!
videos.overview: Berlin is calling! At the Späti video shoot, the top model candidates take on three roles and demonstrate their acting talent. Who will be able to memorize the text in the shortest possible time and embody an emotion?

videos.title: Art Edition
videos.overview: The Art Edition is coming up! Surrounded by fog and wind, the #GNTM models pose in an abandoned ruin in front of colorfully painted wooden walls. They are photographed by Kristian Schuller, who is known for his artistic productions.

videos.title: Casting Edition
videos.overview: Castings, castings and more castings. In the twelfth episode of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum” (Thursday, April 22nd), the seriousness of the modeling business begins for the ten young models.

videos.title: Nude Shoot
videos.overview: The applicants have to bring a lot with them for the upcoming shoot: creativity, body awareness, charm and, last but not least, a lot of self-confidence. Who presents themselves best?

videos.title: It's Fashion Week!
videos.overview: “I'm the smallest and I still want to impress the designers! I now want to show that with my height of 1.68 meters, I too have what it takes to walk at Fashion Week.”

videos.title: Boys Edition
videos.overview: Heart palpitations are inevitable! In a set made of pure ice, the top model candidates pose alongside male models during the photo shoot. Who shows the extreme cold in front of the camera and who skilfully puts themselves in the spotlight?

videos.title: The Semi-finals
videos.overview: Semifinals! The cover shoot for Harper’s Bazaar is coming up. Every pose, every look and every movement of the #GNTM models has to be right here. The fashion show is another highlight: the top model candidates give a personal speech about their #GNTM journey.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: Now all applicants can finally breathe a sigh of relief because the final task has to be completed. Everyone has experienced a lot in the world of fashion and has also had to endure stress.

videos.title: Start in Athens
videos.overview: In front of the impressive backdrop of the Zappeion in Athens, supermodel Heidi Klum personally welcomes her candidates at the start of the 17th #GNTM and surprises them with the first test: an impressive fashion show in front of a live audience.

videos.title: Bootcamp Edition
videos.overview: Eat, sleep, model, repeat. The candidates are still at the beginning of their modeling careers and still have a lot to learn. That's why the second episode has the motto “Bootcamp Edition”.

videos.title: Promo Edition
videos.overview: The Promo Edition is coming! In the third episode, the shooting for the Germany-wide poster campaign for “Germany’s Next Top Model” takes place. Natural beauty is important here: the models remain without make-up and unstyled.

videos.title: Action Edition
videos.overview: And action! The fourth episode has it all. In a spectacular video shoot, the models are catapulted out of a car into the air at the push of a button. Anyone who manages to maintain composure and expression has a good chance of convincing Heidi Klum.

videos.title: Casting Edition
videos.overview: Castings, castings, castings! Heidi Klum gives the model candidates an exclusive casting training before they go to Athens. Who can convince customers at the casting marathon and get the most jobs?

videos.title: The big GNTM Makeover!
videos.overview: Snap, snap, hair off! The big #GNTM makeover is coming up and Heidi Klum has come up with individual looks for the top model candidates: bangs or pixie cut? Blonde bob or dark curls and extensions?

videos.title: Sedcard Shooting
videos.overview: Strike a pose! The comp card shooting is coming up this week and a big surprise awaits the models who do the best. For the decision walk, the candidates transform themselves into dark, wind-up vintage dolls.

videos.title: Social Media Edition
videos.overview: In the social media edition, each model has to promote a crazy product in the style of an influencer in the video shoot. The young models then face a real interview situation and try to demonstrate their social media skills.

videos.title: Fantasy Edition
videos.overview: The Fantasy Edition is coming! Courage and expressiveness are required during a photo shoot. Three models are styled as plush figures and are mounted at a height of ten meters and pose in a competition.

videos.title: Castingmarathon in L.A.
videos.overview: Castings, castings, castings! In L.A., the top model candidates go on a real casting marathon and try to land one of the coveted jobs.

videos.title: Bodypainting Shoot
videos.overview: In the shoot of the week, the models can shine twice as much. Because it's not just the golden body painting that makes her shine, the poses should also be an eye-catcher.

videos.title: Getting into the Top 10
videos.overview: Confidence is key. Not every model is yet able to come out of their shell and exude self-confidence. That's why Nikeata Thompson comes to the villa and gives the models a lesson on self-confidence and self-love.

videos.title: Dream Edition
videos.overview: This week acting talent is in demand. In the video shoot, the models recreate a visit to prison in the 80s. The shooting partner and prisoner is none other than Hollywood star Brigitte Nielsen.

videos.title: Duel Week
videos.overview: Duel week. When it comes to casting, the most important thing is the personality of the model. They should represent their personal superpower through a self-selected outfit and accessory.

videos.title: The Cover Shoot
videos.overview: The cover shoot for Harper’s Bazaar is coming up. Every pose, every look and every movement of the #GNTM models has to be right here. Together with a robot as a partner, each model has to prove to the camera why she belongs on the cover.

videos.title: The Entry into the Final
videos.overview: Semifinals! The shooting demands everything from the semi-finalists. On a 5-meter-high swinging pole, they need constant body tension in order to be able to offer different poses and an expressive face.

videos.title: The grand Finale
videos.overview: Final! After an exciting time in the fashion world, the top model candidates face their final challenge in the 17th season of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”.

videos.title: Welcome to Hollywood!
videos.overview: Supermodel Heidi Klum welcomes her 29 candidates to the start of the 18th season of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum” in a real film city.

videos.title: Duel Mode: The Models are in direct Competition
videos.overview: Duel mode at #GNTM: Each candidate is assigned a direct competitor this week.

videos.title: Express yourself
videos.overview: In the first video shoot of the season, the candidates film their own individual introduction clips.

videos.title: Strike a Pose
videos.overview: The first big photo shoot of the season is coming up for the young models.

videos.title: The Makeover 2023
videos.overview: Snap, snap, hair off! The big #GNTM makeover is coming up and Heidi Klum has come up with individual looks for the top model candidates.

videos.title: Sedcard Shooting
videos.overview: The comp card shooting is coming up. In front of Vicky Lawton's camera, you can see who confidently embodies their new look.

videos.title: Iconic: The Models shoot as Marilyn Monroe
videos.overview: Iconic! During the video shoot, the top model candidates transform into Marilyn Monroe doppelgangers.

videos.title: Surprise! The new ones are here
videos.overview: Surprise! Heidi Klum is always good for a surprise and presents her candidates with a very special challenge.

videos.title: Cuddly Toy Shoot
videos.overview: This week's shoot is tough: the models have to pose in the gripper arm of an XXL cuddly toy machine.

videos.title: Hard-hitting Interviews and Tears: The Social Media Edition
videos.overview: This week the models' interview skills will be put to the test.

videos.title: Casting marathon in Berlin: Who will get the jobs?
videos.overview: Castings, castings, castings. Back in Berlin, the models have the chance to land a coveted runway job at Berlin Fashion Week.

videos.title: Let's Rock! The Models become Music Legends
videos.overview: Music off! This week the models perform to legendary songs from past decades.

videos.title: Surprise! The Models receive Visitors from Home
videos.overview: This week the models receive a visit from their loved ones from home. In the "Rich Girl" shoot they pose in a luxurious penthouse and in the decision walk the models have to do an elegant walk between family and friends.

videos.title: Off to the Desert: An extravagant Photoshoot awaits the Models
videos.overview: Kristian Schuller shoots an extravagant photo with the models: The candidates pose in the middle of the desert with large balls and waving scarves. For the decision walk, the top model candidates run a fashion show in the middle of a highway.

videos.title: Viva Las Vegas: Unforgettable Evening with Heidi Klum
videos.overview: Vegas baby! The models' road trip ends with an unforgettable party evening in Las Vegas. The next day there is a big challenge: the underwater shooting. Who cuts a good figure underwater and who runs out of breath?

videos.title: The Cover Shoot for Harper's BAZAAR
videos.overview: In this episode, the models head to Las Vegas to take part in the prestigious cover shoot for "Harper's Bazaar". The women dress like drag queens and try to wow the audience at a drag brunch.

videos.title: Semifinals
videos.overview: In the semi-finals the models have to push their limits again. Because for this shoot they have to pose on a trapeze at a dizzying height in Cirque du Soleil. The last final tickets are then waiting for the participants.

videos.title: The 2023 Final
videos.overview: Final! After an exciting time in the fashion world, the top model candidates face their final challenge in the 18th season of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”. Who will convince Heidi Klum and her guests in the grand finale and become #GNTM 2023?

videos.title: The big Casting in Berlin
videos.overview: “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum” starts with an innovation: for the 19th season, world star Heidi Klum is calling all of Germany to Berlin for an open casting. It doesn't matter how tall or short, how heavy or light the applicants are, or what gender they identify with. The only condition is that you have to have celebrated your 18th birthday before filming begins. Who will advance one round and go on a big “Germany’s Next Top Model” journey?

videos.title: Casting Fever and important Visitors
videos.overview: Heidi Klum continues her search for “Germany’s Next Top Model” in the historic Wilhelm Hallen and has a very special guest at her side: French fashion designer Jean Paul Gaultier, who gives the young models valuable tips for the catwalk.
