Also a guest: German designer Jasmin Erbas, who will be providing the upcoming fashion show with her collections. Who will make it onto the catwalk?

videos.title: The First Fashion Show: Between Glamor and Tears
videos.overview: It's Showtime! The third round of the open casting in Berlin promises not only glamor, but also a special surprise: the first fashion show in front of an audience is coming up - equipped by the German fashion designer Jasmin Erbas. After the big parade, the model boss, together with the French fashion designer Jean Paul Gaultier, selects the models who will go on the #GNTM journey with her. Off to Tenerife! But who will get on the plane?

videos.title: Viva España – Off to Tenerife!
videos.overview: The models move into their model hacienda in Tenerife. Once there, the self-timer shoot awaits them under the motto “Be yourself”, where the models can take two photos of themselves using the self-timer. Also a group ocean shoot with individually styled and tailored clothing on the coast of Tenerife - photographed by Heidi Klum herself. Actress and model Liz Hurley will be a guest judge.

videos.title: The first Catwalk teaching with Celebrity Support
videos.overview: Today it's all about elegance and expression on the catwalk. Under the guidance of designer Marina Hoermanseder and catwalk professional Jon Kortajarena, the models learn the secret of the perfect catwalk. From head position to the perfect turn – every detail counts! Then the big test: In Hoermanseder's designs, a challenging outdoor catwalk must be mastered. Who convinces Heidi and who stumbles over their own ambitions?

videos.title: The big #GNTM Makeover
videos.overview: Today the models can expect a transformation at the big #GNTM makeover that is as individual as their personalities. And as if that wasn't enough, we then go on to the catwalk appearance in the futuristic Auditorio de Tenerife - a real challenge with style - and, above all, quite a few steps. In the fashion showdown, the models show off their skills in creations by Kaviar Gauche and Baldessarini. But in the end, the only thing that counts is the impression Heidi and Jourdan Dunn make.

videos.title: The first Casting and Comp Card Shooting
videos.overview: Today it will be educational and tricky at the same time. Heidi slips into the role of the critical customer and gives the models a casting lesson! But what they don't know: A real customer is secretly watching and seeing which model has what it takes for the campaign. After the casting, we get straight to the nitty-gritty: comp card shooting with cool designer furniture as a backdrop. Who will withstand the critical gaze of photographer and guest juror Christian Anwander and get the coveted model portfolio?

videos.title: Welcome to Los Angeles!
videos.overview: This week, after the casting marathon in Frankfurt, the models say: Bye, bye Germany. Hello Los Angeles! What awaits you there? A catwalk in the legendary Rose Bowl Stadium, surrounded by football players! The mission: Stay cool and rock Christian Cowan's looks.

videos.title: Interview Training: Tears, Arguments and unpleasant Questions
videos.overview: SAT.1 Newstime spokeswoman and journalist Claudia von Brauchitsch checks how the models do in their first interview. Who remains sovereign? But there is a little secret: Designer Kilian Kerner is secretly watching because he came to L.A. with a very specific mission. But shhh, the models won't find out until later. The designer trains the models in the runway walk and secretly assesses their creativity during the “Tiny Tokyo” photo shoot…

videos.title: Castings, Reels and Haute Couture
videos.overview: Time for haute couture! But first they are looking for a new face for the underwear brand Intimissimi. According to the motto “Italian Morning”, eight models are allowed to demonstrate their skills during the casting and give an insight into their morning routine. Then comes the big high fashion show at the SCS Warehouse. The candidates present the opulent designs on the catwalk and international model Winnie Harlow is at Heidi's side as a guest judge for the elimination.

videos.title: Underwater Shooting: Now it's Time to hold your Breath!
videos.overview: Now hold your breath! Today the models dive underwater and take on the role of a newly married couple. Heidi pays a visit to the model penthouse and gives the candidates tips on how to best portray intimacy in front of the camera. And this is then practiced in the pool. During the big shoot, the models want to show that they can showcase their high fashion wedding outfits in the decorated underwater tank.

videos.title: Fashion Week Special: Three Designers, Three Shows
videos.overview: Running needs to be learned - and today the models are practicing with catwalk trainer Micky Kurz. Also there: the international designers Kevin Germanier, Ashton Michael and Esther Perbandt, who have high demands on the models. It's worth giving everything, because on elimination day there's not just one fashion show, but three! And everyone wants to shine in the cool outfits. The aim is to convince Heidi and the three designers. Who will master the challenge?

videos.title: Ready, Set, Action!
videos.overview: Today it's all about videos. First, the candidates are allowed to get creative during a beauty casting. It's about showing your personal transformation in a video clip, first without make-up and then with your self-made-up look. Then the models' acting skills are in demand. The story? A celebrity enters a diner and has a confrontation with the manager, played by Thomas Kretschmann.

videos.title: It's Showtime! The Models rock the Big Stage
videos.overview: Today the models create colorful beach looks to impress at the casting for a swimwear campaign. Then it gets musical: teaching with dancer and catwalk coach Nikeata shows who has a sense of rhythm. Choreography to hits by Beyoncé and Justin Timberlake makes the models sweat. But if that wasn't enough, there's also the need for lip-sync action! The crowning conclusion is the walk.

videos.title: Monsoon Shoot
videos.overview: Today there are two beauty jobs up for grabs. First of all, more than just batting your eyelashes is required to convince the Lashes customer. Then it's all about hugs and emotions when casting for a deodorant brand. Who lets the customer see inside themselves? During the spectacular monsoon shoot with photographer Rankin, the artificial weather goes crazy. Rain and wind? No problem for the models. Or is it?

videos.title: The big Cover Shoot
videos.overview: The time has finally come – the big cover shoot is coming up! And everyone wants to go to Harper’s Bazaar. That's why it's time to step on the gas for what is probably the most important shoot of the season. Who has what it takes to be a cover star? During the exciting Action Walk the models have to keep their nerve and not look down! Because the catwalk is at dizzying heights. Who wants to aim high and convince Heidi Klum?

videos.title: Family & Friends
videos.overview: Creativity is key! Today the models are supposed to let their creativity run wild at a big casting for a sportswear manufacturer. The task? Create a style where the shoe is the hero. Who will be one step ahead and get the job? Hard work is rewarded: family and friends surprise the models in L.A.! The models can recharge their batteries with their loved ones so they can score points in the important shoot with Thomas Hayo and Kristian Schuller.

videos.title: Semifinals
videos.overview: The models aim high. And definitely don't fly out so close to the finish line. During the helicopter shoot, you have to show strong nerves and impress photographer and guest juror Vijat Mohindra. Who gets to make it to the grand finale will be decided during a spectacular rooftop walk in front of the L.A. skyline with designer and guest juror Yannik Zamboni. Which models will get the long-awaited ticket to the #GNTM final 2024?

videos.title: Final
videos.overview: Final! After an exciting time in the fashion world, the top model candidates face their final challenge in the 19th season of “Germany’s Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum”. Premiere: There will be two winners this year! A female winner and a male winner will each receive €100,000 and will grace the cover of Harper's Bazaar. Who will convince Heidi Klum and her guests in the grand finale in Cologne and become #GNTM 2024?

videos.title: Ladies First
videos.overview: 20 years of glamorous photoshoots, 20 years of challenging catwalks and challenges, 20 years of "Germany's Next Top Model – by Heidi Klum"! Heidi Klum kicks off the anniversary season of "Germany's Next Top Model" with her daughter Leni Klum as a guest judge.

videos.title: Who will win over Naomi Campbell? The search for the next top model husband begins
videos.overview: Casting fever and a high-profile #GNTM visitor in Munich! International supermodel Naomi Campbell is supporting Heidi Klum in her search for "Germany's Next Top Model" 2025.

videos.title: Glamour, drama, catwalk fear! Who will master the first fashion show?
videos.overview: Heidi Klum continues the anniversary season with a glamorous highlight! The models have to demonstrate their skills at an exclusive fitting by designer Lessja Verlingieri.

videos.title: Iconic! The male models present Karl Lagerfeld designs
videos.overview: It's showtime! The male models are competing in their first major fashion show—and it's a real eye-catcher! Outfitted by Karl Lagerfeld's head designer, Hun Kim, the candidates present their iconic designs on the runway. Czech supermodel Eva Herzigová is there, offering final tips and watching the show with Heidi Klum. But the pressure is on: Who has what it takes to impress the judges and secure their spot in the model house?

videos.title: Tears don't lie! Who impresses with genuine emotions in front of the camera?
videos.overview: Today, the models face a special challenge: tears are expected to roll down their cheeks during a photo shoot with photographer Lado Alexi – no easy task for the aspiring models. Things are more cheerful on the catwalk during the butterfly walk. Equipped with butterfly wings, the candidates must gracefully stride down the runway. Who will impress Heidi Klum and her guest judge, Dutch model Romee Strijd, and who will ultimately let their butterfly wings hang loose?

videos.title: Tough on the outside, soft on the inside? The boys show their emotional side!
videos.overview: Oh là là! She's the grande dame of French cinema and a true style icon: Catherine Deneuve. Together with male supermodel David Gandy, they support Heidi Klum on the catwalk. And it's quite a challenge: The candidates have to walk the cobblestones in their outfits. But before that, they're given the task of showing off their softer side during a photo shoot. Now, tears are expected to roll down their cheeks.

videos.title: The Big Makeover
videos.overview: The makeover episode is always a rollercoaster of emotions. As the contestants sit nervously in the salon chairs, tension fills the air. They have no idea what transformations Heidi Klum has planned for them. Will it be a dramatic cut, a bold new color, or something completely unexpected? But not every contestant will undergo a transformation—Heidi Klum carefully selects those whose potential she believes can be enhanced.

videos.title: Foam party! The GNTM boys strip off
videos.overview: Exciting news for the men! They've received the news that not only a makeover, but also a nude photoshoot is coming up. For the subsequent Future Walk, the models will be coached by the winner of the first #GNTM season, Lena Gercke, and male model Johannes Huebl. The outfits are made of innovative materials such as reflective fabrics and metallic accents. The styling is simple, monochrome, and minimalist. Who will beam their way to the next round?

videos.title: Sedcard shoot with Yu Tsai! Who delivers?
videos.overview: A model photoshoot is essential for a model's career. For this model photoshoot with renowned photographer Yu Tsai, each model is photographed in striking black and white. The models are given creative freedom to create their own poses or pose elegantly on a chair. The subsequent fashion show takes place against the breathtaking backdrop of Tüßling Castle – a tribute to Twiggy's most iconic looks from the 1960s.

videos.title: Heidi Klum conquers the Munich Hofbräuhaus with her models!
videos.overview: Pork knuckle, dumplings, red cabbage. Heidi Klum and her male models take a trip to Munich's Hofbräuhaus. But then model life calls again: Of course, the men also need a comp card. They've just finished exercising, and then immediately have to go to the photo set. Who can handle the change of location best? In Munich's breathtaking Müller'sches Volksbad, the men walk a spectacular catwalk...

videos.title: L.A. calling: Off to the City of Angels
videos.overview: Off to L.A.! But unfortunately, not all models will be able to move into the stylish model loft. First, they have to prove themselves on the runway. The subsequent elimination round will decide who gets to take the next flight back home. They can also snag their first jobs.

videos.title: Castings, castings, castings! Who will secure the jobs?
videos.overview: Things are getting serious for the #GNTM boys: The first auditions are coming up, and with them the chance to land real jobs. Then the men will also begin their journey to L.A. But before they can move into the penthouse, they have to prove themselves on the catwalk.

videos.title: New dynamics in L.A.: Boys & Girls meet
videos.overview: The candidates – one small group at a time – move into their new home for the next few weeks: a penthouse in L.A. There, the men and women meet for the first time. The models have to decide for themselves who will share a room with whom. Car wash shoot with an icon: Star photographer Ellen von Unwerth photographs the models with soapy water and sponges. But first, they have to split up into pairs.

videos.title: Puppet walk and fashion week fever!
videos.overview: "Puppet Walk" vs. Fashion Week! While some models perform as life-size puppets, others walk the runway at Berlin Fashion Week. And: Top model Adriana Lima helps Heidi decide.

videos.title: Action-packed week with a Western walk, casting, and "Mountain Rescue" shoot!
videos.overview: In an action-packed episode, the models experience the stressful jet-set life of a model. After Berlin Fashion Week, some travel to LA, while the winner of the Zadig & Voltaire campaign flies to Paris. Actor Sebastian Ströbel leads an acting workshop, followed by a video shoot for "Der Bergretter" (The Mountain Rescuer). At the Intimissimi casting, the face of the new campaign is sought. The highlight is a Western walk with Paris Jackson as guest judge.

videos.title: Dust, Wind & Tears! "Mad Max" Adventure in the Desert
videos.overview: From high fashion to high adventure! In the 16th episode, the models are treated to a truly contrasting program. First, they have to shine at the Pandora casting. Then it's off to the desert for an epic "Mad Max" shoot. And as the crowning finale: a night in a tent under the sparkling desert sky. Pure glamour and adventure!

videos.title: Glamour, acrobatics & transformation: Welcome to the #GNTM circus
videos.overview: Whether acrobat, juggler, or dancer, every circus performer has a wealth of acting talent. And that's exactly what's needed now, because the models have to demonstrate versatility by slipping into different roles in the circus setting. For the shoot, they become marionettes, so that guest judge and star photographer Kristian Schuller can capture them performing Pinocchio-like movements. On the catwalk, the models wear typical circus costumes...

videos.title: Dizzying heights & tough courses - who will master the action week?
videos.overview: At the casting for the new CALZEDONIA campaign, the models show off their best side. In keeping with the "action" theme, which is what this episode is all about, the next day's "Balance Beam" shoot takes them to the skies, as photographer Max Montgomery photographs the models on a narrow beam. The Elimination Walk takes them through an obstacle course, where they have to impress Heidi Klum, designer Kevin Germanier, and supermodel Coco Rocha.

videos.title: Paris Hilton at #GNTM: Who will convince Heidi & the megastar?
videos.overview: During the "COLOR SPLASH" photo shoot, the models are attached to a rotating wheel and pelted with paint by Heidi. The following day, the models receive a visit from former #GNTM semifinalist Betty Taube, who hosts a hidden casting call for ORGANICS by Red Bull. The models shoot "day-in-the-life" videos intended to represent their summer vibes. For the Elimination Walk, the models wear tape looks and glowing wings designed by Drakhan Blackhart.

videos.title: Drag Edition! The models show their most dazzling side
videos.overview: Heidi Klum has a very special surprise for her models: The drag edition is coming up! The GNTM candidates have to prove they're true quick-change artists. But that's not all: Some models will have the chance to secure a spot in the new SAMSUNG campaign.

videos.title: Oscar Glamour & Entry into the top 10
videos.overview: Oscar glamour at #GNTM! Heidi Klum brings some models to the Oscar party, dressed in gowns by Kilian Kerner. At the photo shoot, the nominees show off plenty of skin, sporting airbrushed tattoos by artist Grace x Lovejoy, before star photographer Brian Bowen Smith. Dean & Dan Caten (DSQUARED2) help Heidi decide.

videos.title: Surprise! A Visit from Home
videos.overview: First, the models recharge their batteries with quality time with family and friends. The final decision will be made during an alien-style walk in fashion by designer Yannik Zamboni.

videos.title: Press-teaching & posing on wheels! Who can withstand the pressure?
videos.overview: The models receive training in professional communication from Christian Düren, learning how to master interviews and Q&A sessions and how to improve their social media presence. During the interview, they face questions from the press, with Christian observing and providing feedback. During the photo shoot with Rankin, the models must pose in pairs in a moving bed. The final selection takes place at the "Public Walk" in Hollywood.

videos.title: Semifinal: Who will shine at the Harper's Bazaar cover shoot?
videos.overview: The time has finally come – the big cover shoot is upon us! The dream of appearing on the cover of Harper's Bazaar is within reach, but only those who deliver absolute top performance in the all-important cover shoot have a chance. Afterwards, the top model candidates must prove their good walk and sense of style in the quick-change walk. Who will impress the judges with their self-chosen outfits and snag one of the coveted spots in the finale?

videos.title: The finale of the anniversary Season
videos.overview: It will be the crowning conclusion of the anniversary season and a super party of the highest order! Today, Heidi Klum will crown one winner and one winner of the 20th #GNTM season in a grand live finale at the Coloneum in Cologne. Both will receive a cover in Harper's Bazaar, €100,000 each, and become part of L'Oréal Paris's "We Are Worth It" campaign. Who will follow in Lea and Jermaine's footsteps and become "Germany's Next Top Model" 2025?
